title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Rate Card Note: Returning-Customer Rate on the Alignment Check Fee
content:
The returning-customer rate on the alignment check fee of an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is **0.80** where the vehicle has a network insurance claim repair delivered no more than 730 days before the day the charge is posted and that repair's class is a structural class (its name contains Structural); it is **0.90** where that repair was delivered no more than 730 days before and is of a non-structural class, or was delivered more than 730 but no more than 1460 days before; otherwise it is **1**.

The rate multiplies the tier's alignment check fee for one check.

## Records the rate is read from

The rate is read from the vehicle's Insurance Claim Repairs record with the network: the repair's delivered date and its repair class name. A class is structural where its name contains the word Structural.

Days are calendar days counted from the repair's delivered date to the day the alignment check charge is posted, the delivered date not counted. Where the vehicle has no delivered network insurance claim repair on record, the days are taken as 99999, beyond every band, and the rate is 1.

## Rate table

| Days from the claim repair's delivery to the day the charge is posted | Structural class | Non-structural class |
|---|---|---|
| no more than 730 | 0.80 | 0.90 |
| more than 730, no more than 1460 | 0.90 | 0.90 |
| more than 1460, or no delivered claim repair | 1 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Delivered 730 days before the posting day, class name contains Structural: 0.80.
- Delivered 731 days before, class name contains Structural: 0.90.
- Delivered 1460 days before, any class: 0.90.
- Delivered 1461 days before, any class: 1.

## Illustration (hypothetical fee for one check of 59.95 USD)

At a rate of 0.80, the fee for one check becomes 59.95 multiplied by 0.80, that is 47.96 USD; at 0.90 it becomes 53.955 USD.
